name: MYSTERIOUS LANGUAGE
title: E. MYSTERIOUS LANGUAGE
legend: You are given a mysterious language (codenamed "Secret") available in "Custom Test" tab. Find out what this language is and write a program which outputs its name. Note that the program must be written in this language.
input_spec: This program has only one test, and it's empty (it doesn't give your program anything to read).
output_spec: Output the name of the mysterious language.
